scientific_question: Which publicly documented source studies, species descriptions and measurement regimes contribute matched reproductive and vegetative trait observations to the 279 K-blind same-AusTraits-dataset family×pair cohorts?

original_eligibility.native_unit_validity: Must reproduce the original 254 source-native eligible species medians and all 279 same-DatasetID positive source species×pair counts before reporting provenance concentration.

metadata_only_audit.source_unit: AusTraits contributing dataset_id is a provenance label, not necessarily a single originally sampled study
metadata_only_audit.aggregate: For each original qualified family×pair×species, count contributing DatasetIDs whose native-unit positive records exist for both traits. Aggregate distinct family×pair×species cells by public DatasetID; avoid double-counting duplicate observations in one dataset.
counts: number of species×pair cells with multiple shared original DatasetIDs
top source DatasetIDs by positive species×pair cell coverage
fraction of all shared source support associated with each dataset ID, allowing >100% sum due to overlapping datasets
metadata_only_audit.public_source_citations: Retrieve original pinned data/{dataset_id}/metadata.yml primary titles/DOI, description, basis_of_record, native trait var/method tags and value_type for both paired traits.
metadata_only_audit.auto_source_grouping: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY: Source metadata may explicitly mention a flora/online species profile, a compiled database/collation, an individually measured collection, or be unclassified. Never certify independence or measurement homology from keyword tags.
metadata_only_audit.prevent_pubmed_claim: No bibliographic citation can establish identical original specimen measurement or independent external replication without record-level provenance.

exploratory_classification.provisional_direct_measurement: Only indicate if both native traits explicitly identify measurement basis and dataset record type field/preserved specimen, without floristic/compilation indicators. NEVER call it independently validated primary data.

guardrails: All metadata labels are post-outcome exploratory descriptions, never new K-based source selection.
Do not filter out source IDs or recalibrate source-OU process parameters after seeing their trait K effects.
A shared AusTraits dataset ID, even same observation key, does not prove the same individual was measured for two organs.
No new independent TRY v7 validation exists; do not reopen closed BIEN 201-system rho analysis.
